title: Polyscene: Scenario Planning as Diversity Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.28102v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scenario planning is a foresight practice in which analysts construct a small set of plausible futures and prepare an organisation for each. Each scenario is a narrative that must be plausible, internally consistent, relevant and challenging, and the set as a whole must be differentiated. The practice remains manual: a workshop (i.e., a facilitated meeting in which a small group of experts writes the narratives) considers only the factors it has time for, carries the biases of the experts who run it, and cannot be redone whenever conditions change. In this paper, we automate scenario planning by casting it as a diversity planning problem, in which two scenarios differ when they end in different narratives on the analyst's drivers. The result is a set of scenarios, one for each narrative that the topic can reach within a budget. Our implementation, Polyscene, is a generic engine that generates scenarios from a topic. translated_title: Polyscene：将情景规划作为多样性规划
translated_abstract: 情景规划是一种前瞻性实践，分析师构建少量合理的未来情景，并为每一种情景做好组织准备。每个情景都是一个叙述，必须合理、内部一致、相关且具有挑战性，而整个情景集合则必须具有差异性。这一实践目前仍依赖人工：研讨会（即由一小群专家撰写叙述的引导性会议）只考虑其有时间顾及的因素，带有主持专家的偏见，并且无法在条件变化时重新进行。本文通过将情景规划转化为一个多样性规划问题来实现其自动化：当两个情景在分析师关注的驱动因素上以不同的叙述结束时，它们即被视为不同。其结果是一组情景，即该主题在给定预算内所能达到的每个叙述各对应一个情景。我们的实现 Polyscene 是一个通用引擎，能够从一个主题生成情景。我们使用地缘政治案例（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文将传统依赖人工专家研讨会的情景规划重新表述为多样性规划问题，并开发了通用引擎 Polyscene，实现了具有差异性的情景集合的自动化生成。
en_tdlr: This paper recasts scenario planning, traditionally a manual workshop-based practice, as a diversity planning problem and introduces Polyscene, a generic engine that automatically generates differentiated sets of scenarios from a topic.
